description:
See how conversations unfold in real time while out on a mission in this latest Exodus video highlighting work-in-progress gameplay from the upcoming sci-fi action-adventure RPG. Join Jun Aslan and Phaedra (a combat companion) as they embark on a mission hunting Remnants in a Celestial facility. The video showcases the characters in conversation, as Jun describes the environment to Phaedra, who has been infected by a Celestia virus that left her blind. The video also showcases how dialogue options branch in real time, as we get a look at how conversation choices shape the player’s relationships and the larger narrative of Exodus.

Extended gameplay for Exodus will be revealed in summer 2026.

Exodus will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Hardhats: Some Survival Required announcement trailer for this upcoming four-player co-op building adventure game that blends clumsy construction with survival and FPS elements. Hardhats: Some Survival Required will be available on PC, and a demo will be coming to Steam Next Fest in June 2026.

In Hardhats: Some Survival Required, don your hardhat as an intrepid and… inexpensive construction worker, willing to brave the farthest and most dangerous sites to get the job done. ​ Work together with your crew to construct elaborate (and often incomplete) build plans. ​

Wield the tools of your trade: nailgun, sledgehammer, power gloves, dynamite, and more, to bust apart the scenery for raw materials. Fight local fauna to feed yourself, transport perilous towers of furniture, and hold together your slapdash architecture so the client is happy… enough.
